slices.focus: A locum shift exposes workflow fragility, leading to a mandatory one-page bench guide
slices.summary: A regular locum leaves messy annotations and a controlled-drug script is misfiled, exposing that Saira's workflow collapses when temporary staff ignore it. She writes a one-page locum bench guide and pushes for mandatory sign-in review. Peter half-agrees to a trial.
open_loops: Peter's sign-in approval is only a half-yes pending two-week review
Controlled-drug section on the guide needs boxed emphasis
Tiny log of guide usage needs to be maintained for two weeks
School-run period remains highest-risk pressure point
decisions: Saira remained operations lead, but after a rushed shift exposed weak locum compliance she widened her workflow project
Saira's mental state sharpened from background stress into being more tightly wound because staffing gaps now threatened
